title: Angrath | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about the minotaur Planeswalker Angrath, the Flame-Chained, from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: Angrath is driven by a feeling of restless impatience, like a caged animal awaiting its moment of freedom. This fuels his wild temper and spurs him on in an endless series of raids upon the coastal towns of the Sun Empire.
